plan.title: Scholarship Application Overview
plan.subtitle: Summary of applicant demographics, financial status, and processing outcomes

panels.title: Approved Rate
panels.sql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate FROM "scholarship_applicants"

panels.title: Avg Family Income
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM "scholarship_applicants"

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top Schemes by Volume
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS total_apps, AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
